Cricket: England player retires, India faces player unavailability

England's star batter has announced retirement, with her final match to be against India. Separately, India's team faces player unavailability issues ahead of a series against England. One Indian player, Prateek Rawal, is out of a match against England. Another Indian spinner, Varun Chakravarthy, was previously ruled out of the final T20 matches due to a hamstring injury. Meanwhile, Indian captain Rohit Sharma has arrived in England and is practicing, with a strong past record in ODIs there, including seven centuries.
